note: This skill owns DRIVING an already-approved estate-overhaul plan end to end — scope confirm, measure, plan, then gated wave execution composing rename-planning/rename-execute, reshape-skill, and build-lead. Generating the plan itself routes to overhaul-planning (the reciprocal fence: n01/n09/n10 prove that boundary from this side). Ships 2026-08-14 (issue #241, enforcing #238's E1 sign-off) as a skill with an identically-named command wrapper (/overhaul-execute) per the reverse-wrapper grammar amendment — before this ticket, overhaul-execute existed only as a standalone command (PR #240, issue #238) because no legal skill-grammar production existed for a verb-terminal name. No prior eval history for the skill surface; n10/n11 in overhaul-planning's own suite were re-pointed from the command name to this skill in the same change (#241) since the routing judge's real competitor is the skill, not the (non-model-invocable) command.
